data.name: Reflections
data.search: tag:scaffold -is:suspended deck:Scaffold::SI/PI (tag:kc::kc-si-characteristic-impedance OR tag:kc::kc-si-instantaneous-impedance OR tag:kc::kc-si-reflection-coefficient)
data.instructions: In Anki: Tools → Create Filtered Deck, name it "Reflections", paste the search, and keep "Reschedule cards based on my answers" on. Emptying the deck returns every card to its subject deck.
